content: To serialize the required AUTOSAR data types (signed and unsigned integer) into the response message of ReadDataByIdentifier (0x22) OBD- DataIdentifier responses the target endianness configured in DcmDspDataEndian- ness shall be considered for DcmDspData elements having DcmDspDataUsePort set to { USE_DATA_SENDER_RECEIVER , USE_DATA_SENDER_RECEIVER_AS_SER- VICE , USE_ECU_SIGNAL }. In case DcmDspDataEndianness is not present, the DcmDspDataDefaultEndianness shall be used instead.
